drafted: Plain JSON values keep JSON.stringify's exact output, compact, so today's message for plain objects is unchanged.
`undefined` is shown, as a top-level value, an array element and an object property (`"k":undefined`).
BigInt displays as `12n`; NaN and the infinities by name.
Maps and Sets display as `Map {k => v, ...}` and `Set {v, ...}` in insertion order.
Class instances get their constructor's name in front; plain and null-prototype objects do not.
Functions are `[Function name]` or `[Function]`; Errors are `[Name: message]`; symbols are `Symbol(desc)`.
Objects with toJSON (Dates) display what toJSON returns.
A value inside itself is `[Circular]`; shared values are shown in full.
A getter that throws displays the error as a value; displayValue never throws.
The display is cut at 200 UTF-16 code units, then `…`.
Seam (the files the stub writes): src/errors.ts
Allowed paths (what the implementer may change): src/errors.ts
